tokens.name: surface-page
tokens.usage: Page background behind every section and card.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, stat tiles, chart cards, the ticker strip and full-width bands such as Our data.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Resting fill of an unselected route option on white.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: The navy console that holds the route map, and the detail panel. Never used as a whole-page dark mode.

tokens.name: surface-inverse-raised
tokens.usage: Stat tiles, segmented-control track and selected route options inside a surface-inverse panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Headings and primary text on surface-page, surface-raised, surface-subtle and coral (17.5:1 on white, 6.2:1 on coral).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Body copy and secondary text on surface-page and surface-raised (9.2:1 on surface-page).

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Meta text 13–14px: chart captions, sources, footer, on surface-page and surface-raised (7.2:1 on surface-page).

tokens.name: on-inverse
tokens.usage: Headings, values and button text on surface-inverse, surface-inverse-raised and blue.

tokens.name: on-inverse-strong
tokens.usage: Unselected segmented-control labels and steady trend values on surface-inverse-raised (11.3:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-soft
tokens.usage: Map stop labels and secondary lines on surface-inverse (11.4:1).

tokens.name: on-inverse-muted
tokens.usage: Eyebrows and stat labels on surface-inverse (8.8:1) and surface-inverse-raised (7.4:1).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: The brand colour: primary buttons, selected chips, route 1, the serif accent words in headings (5.4:1 on surface-page), focus rings on light grounds.

tokens.name: blue-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of primary buttons.

tokens.name: blue-text
tokens.usage: Inline links and eyebrows on surface-page and surface-raised.

tokens.name: blue-light
tokens.usage: Route 1 line and swatch on surface-inverse (6.1:1).

tokens.name: blue-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Route 1 destination label and rising trend values on surface-inverse (9.5:1).

tokens.name: blue-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Rising trend pill.

tokens.name: blue-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Rising trend pill on blue-tint (7.3:1) and rising KPI values on white.

tokens.name: blue-tile-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a blue stat block (4.7:1).

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: The second brand colour: the closing call-to-action band, route 3 on surface-inverse. Text on coral is always ink or coral-ink-deep, never white.

tokens.name: coral-strong
tokens.usage: Route 3 marks on white: chart lines, bars, meters, swatches (4.0:1 on white). Not for text under 24px.

tokens.name: coral-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Route 3 destination label on surface-inverse (8.5:1).

tokens.name: coral-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Cooling trend pill.

tokens.name: coral-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the Cooling trend pill on coral-tint (7.0:1).

tokens.name: coral-ink-deep
tokens.usage: Body text on coral (6.2:1).

tokens.name: neutral-tint
tokens.usage: Fill of the Steady trend pill; its text is ink-muted (8.6:1).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines between bands, card and ticker borders, unselected route option borders. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Resting border of unselected chips and the chart baseline.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Border of the secondary button. Only 1.4:1 on surface-page, so the button must always carry a text label; never use it as the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: border-inverse
tokens.usage: Resting border of route options and dividers on surface-inverse. Decorative only; selection is shown by fill and a light border.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty track of overlap bars and rings on white.

tokens.name: track-inverse
tokens.usage: Empty track of overlap bars and rings on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Chart gridlines on white.

tokens.name: chart-muted
tokens.usage: Earlier-month bars in the openings chart (3.2:1 on white).

tokens.name: chart-reference
tokens.usage: Dashed reference line for the user's current role (3.0:1 on white).

tokens.name: chart-axis
tokens.usage: Line chart baseline. Decorative.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 3px focus ring, 3px offset, on surface-page and surface-raised (5.4:1 or better).

tokens.name: focus-on-inverse
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside surface-inverse panels (17.5:1).

tokens.name: focus-on-coral
tokens.usage: Focus ring inside the coral band (6.2:1).

styles.name: display
styles.sample: Your next career, by the numbers.
styles.usage: The one hero headline per page. Scale fluidly down to 44px on phones (clamp(44px, 6vw, 84px)).

styles.name: display-accent
styles.usage: The two to four accent words inside a display or heading line, in blue. Never a whole heading.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Section headings (h2). Scale down to 32px on phones.

styles.name: cta-heading
styles.usage: The heading inside the coral call-to-action band.

styles.name: panel-title
styles.usage: Title of a navy console or insight card.

styles.name: route-title
styles.usage: The selected destination role in the detail panel (h3).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Pick where you are today. Modulate maps the routes your skills connect to.
styles.usage: The paragraph under a display or heading, in ink-muted, max 580px wide.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The few skills that close the gap, and the job titles to search for.
styles.usage: Running text, list items, skill lists.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented controls, route option titles.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The value in a stat tile; 26px inside the navy console.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Chart axes, sources, the Illustrative tag, in ink-subtle.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label above a title or stat. ink-subtle on light, on-inverse-muted on navy.

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Padding inside a segmented-control track; gap between its options.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; gap inside a stat tile.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between route options and between stat tiles in the console.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between stat tiles on light; small card padding.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Gap between cards in a row; detail-card internal gap.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Page side gutter and header padding.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Gap between hero columns.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Console padding at desktop; gap between bands of content.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Top padding of the hero.

tokens.name: space-5xl
tokens.usage: Vertical padding of full-width bands.

tokens.name: space-6xl
tokens.usage: Bottom padding before the footer.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max width of the page container.

tokens.name: radius-bar
tokens.usage: Top corners of chart bars and small swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Options inside a segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Route options, segmented-control track.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Stat tiles inside the navy console.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Stat tiles on light, data blocks.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Cards: detail panel, chart cards.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: The navy console and the coral call-to-action band.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, trend pills, meters.

tokens.name: shadow-console
tokens.usage: The navy console only.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Optional lift for a white card on surface-page; most cards go without.
